helpTitle: Job title shown in the org chart.
helpRole: Organizational role. Determines position and capabilities.
helpReportsTo: The agent this one reports to in the org hierarchy.
helpCapabilities: Describes what this agent can do. Shown in the org chart and used for task routing.
helpAdapterType: How this agent runs: local CLI (Claude/Codex/OpenCode), OpenClaw Gateway, spawned process, or generic HTTP webhook.
helpCwd: Deprecated legacy working directory fallback for local adapters. Existing agents may still carry this value, but new configurations should use project workspaces instead.
helpPromptTemplate: Sent on every heartbeat. Keep this small and dynamic. Use it for current-task framing, not large static instructions. Supports {{ agent.id }}, {{ agent.name }}, {{ agent.role }} and other template variables.
helpModel: Override the default model used by the adapter.
helpThinkingEffort: Control model reasoning depth. Supported values vary by adapter/model.
helpChrome: Enable Claude's Chrome integration by passing --chrome.
helpDangerouslySkipPermissions: Run unattended by auto-approving adapter permission prompts when supported.
helpDangerouslyBypassSandbox: Run Codex without sandbox restrictions. Required for filesystem/network access.
helpSearch: Enable Codex web search capability during runs.
helpFastMode: Enable Codex Fast mode. This burns credits/tokens much faster and is supported on GPT-6, GPT-5.6, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, and manual Codex model IDs.
helpWorkspaceStrategy: How Paperclip should realize an execution workspace for this agent. Keep project_primary for normal cwd execution, or use git_worktree for issue-scoped isolated checkouts.
helpWorkspaceBaseRef: Base git ref used when creating a worktree branch. Leave blank to use the resolved workspace ref or HEAD.
helpWorkspaceBranchTemplate: Template for naming derived branches. Supports {{issue.identifier}}, {{issue.title}}, {{agent.name}}, {{project.id}}, {{workspace.repoRef}}, and {{slug}}.
helpWorktreeParentDir: Directory where derived worktrees should be created. Absolute, ~-prefixed, and repo-relative paths are supported.
helpRuntimeServicesJson: Optional workspace runtime service definitions. Use this for shared app servers, workers, or other long-lived companion processes attached to the workspace.
helpMaxTurnsPerRun: Maximum number of agentic turns (tool calls) per heartbeat run.
helpCommand: The command to execute (e.g. node, python).
helpLocalCommand: Override the path to the CLI command you want the adapter to call (e.g. /usr/local/bin/claude, codex, opencode).
helpExtraArgs: Extra CLI arguments for local adapters, comma-separated.
helpEnvVars: Environment variables injected into the adapter process. Use plain values or secret references.
helpSecretAccess: Secrets this agent can reach. Env-var bindings are injected at run start; API-access bindings are fetched on demand via the run-bound agent API and never written to the environment.
helpBootstrapPrompt: Only sent when Paperclip starts a fresh session. Use this for stable setup guidance that should not be repeated on every heartbeat.
helpPayloadTemplateJson: Optional JSON merged into remote adapter request payloads before Paperclip adds its standard wake and workspace fields.
helpWebhookUrl: The URL that receives POST requests when the agent is invoked.
helpHeartbeatInterval: Run this agent automatically on a timer. Useful for periodic tasks like checking for new work.
helpTimeoutSec: Maximum seconds a run can take before being terminated. 0 means no timeout.
helpGraceSec: Seconds to wait after sending interrupt before force-killing the process.
helpWakeOnDemand: Allow this agent to be woken by assignments, API calls, UI actions, or automated systems.
helpCooldownSec: Minimum seconds between consecutive heartbeat runs.
helpMaxConcurrentRuns: Maximum number of heartbeat runs that can execute simultaneously for this agent.
helpMaxTurnContinuationEnabled: Automatically queue bounded continuation runs when an adapter stops because its per-run turn cap was exhausted.
helpMaxTurnContinuationMaxAttempts: Maximum automatic continuations after one max-turn stop. This is separate from max turns per run.
helpMaxTurnContinuationDelaySec: Seconds to wait before starting each max-turn continuation.
helpBudgetMonthlyCents: Monthly spending limit in cents. 0 means no limit.
defaultUsesACPIfACPIsUnavailableTheRunFa: Default uses ACP. If ACP is unavailable, the run fails with a setup error. Choose CLI explicitly to use it.
optionalOverrideForTheClaudeACPServerCom: Optional override for the Claude ACP server command. Defaults to the package-local claude-agent-acp binary.
persistentKeepsACPSessionStateBetweenRun: Persistent keeps ACP session state between runs. One-shot starts fresh each run.
fallbackIfTheACPAgentAsksForInputOutside: Fallback if the ACP agent asks for input outside an interactive session.
optionalACPSessionStateDirectoryDefaults: Optional ACP session state directory. Defaults to Paperclip-managed company/agent scoped storage.
defaultsTo0WhichClosesTheACPProcessAfter: Defaults to 0, which closes the ACP process after each run while retaining persistent session state.
optionalOverrideForTheCodexACPServerComm: Optional override for the Codex ACP server command. Defaults to the package-local codex-acp binary.
optionalOverrideForTheGeminiACPServerCom: Optional override for the Gemini ACP server command. Defaults to gemini --acp.
hermesAPIServerBaseURLSuchAsHttp1270: Hermes API server base URL, such as http://127.0.0.1:8642 or a private HTTPS URL. The default dashboard root or chat URL, such as http://127.0.0.1:9119/chat, is accepted and maps to /api.
hermesAPISERVERKEYNotPAPERCLIPAPIKEYStor: Hermes API_SERVER_KEY, not PAPERCLIP_API_KEY. Stored as a Paperclip secret reference.
unsafeDevOnlyEscapeHatchRemoteHermesGate: Unsafe dev-only escape hatch. Remote Hermes gateways should use HTTPS; loopback HTTP remains allowed.
controlsXHermesSessionKeyIssueScopedPrev: Controls X-Hermes-Session-Key. Issue scoped prevents cross-task memory bleed by default.
delayBeforeReconnectingTheHermesSSEEvent: Delay before reconnecting the Hermes SSE events stream after a nonterminal disconnect.
optionalPaperclipAPIURLReachableByTheRem: Optional Paperclip API URL reachable by the remote Hermes host. This is not a credential.
optionalJSONObjectOfExtraNonsecretHeader: Optional JSON object of extra nonsecret headers. Security-critical headers are generated by the adapter.
optionalStableHermesInstructionsSentSepa: Optional stable Hermes instructions sent separately from the wake input.
usuallyAutoSetThisOnlyWhenHermesCannotIn: Usually auto. Set this only when Hermes cannot infer the provider from the model or ~/.hermes/config.yaml.
secondsToWaitAfterSIGTERMBeforeKillingTh: Seconds to wait after SIGTERM before killing the Hermes process.
optionalHermesMaxTurnsLimitForToolCallin: Optional Hermes --max-turns limit for tool-calling iterations.
optionalCommaSeparatedHermesToolsetsSuch: Optional comma-separated Hermes toolsets, such as terminal,file,web.
resumeHermesSessionsAcrossPaperclipHeart: Resume Hermes sessions across Paperclip heartbeats.
passHermesQuietForCleanerPaperclipRunTra: Pass Hermes --quiet for cleaner Paperclip run transcripts.
optionalAPIBaseOverrideDefaultsToPAPERCL: Optional API base override. Defaults to PAPERCLIP_API_URL.
optionalCustomPromptTemplateWithVariable: Optional custom prompt template with {{variable}} placeholders.

codexRunsAutomaticallyInsideARootDeniedW: Codex runs automatically inside a root-denied, workspace-scoped, network-disabled Paperclip environment.
runWithoutCodexApprovalPausesWhilePaperc: Run without Codex approval pauses while Paperclip keeps its independent workspace, network, and environment restrictions.
controlsOpenCodeToolPermissionsInsideThe: Controls OpenCode tool permissions inside the assigned Paperclip environment.
allowOpenCodeOperationsWithoutApprovalPa: Allow OpenCode operations without approval pauses.
claudeManagedRunsNonInteractivelyUnderIt: Claude Managed runs non-interactively under its qualified provider profile and Paperclip policy.
awsAgentCoreRunsNonInteractivelyUnderIts: AWS AgentCore runs non-interactively under its qualified harness profile and Paperclip policy.
grokBotUsesFirstPartyPaperclipToolsAndRe: Grok Bot uses first-party Paperclip tools and retains its native apps. Grok manages its model; spending, live steering, provider transcript streaming and remote interruption are unavailable.
museUsesTheAdmittedPaperclipToolCatalogA: Muse uses the admitted Paperclip tool catalog and its own approved tools. Provider usage is unavailable and remote stop is best effort.
dotUsesTheAdmittedPaperclipToolCatalogOp: Dot uses the admitted Paperclip tool catalog. OpenAI manages its model and other tools; provider usage and global interruption are unavailable.
cursorManagesCommandsAndFilesInItsCloudE: Cursor manages commands and files in its cloud environment. Assigned Paperclip tools retain company permissions. Provider command approvals and verified model identity are unavailable.
controlsACPXAgentOperationsInsideTheAssi: Controls ACPX agent operations inside the assigned Paperclip environment.
approveACPXOperationsWithoutApprovalPaus: Approve ACPX operations without approval pauses.
automaticallyRunAssignedPaperclipPlannin: Automatically run assigned Paperclip planning and task tools, including reassignment. Company permissions and approval requirements still apply. Other operations require permission.
automaticallyAllowAssignedPaperclipReadT: Automatically allow assigned Paperclip read tools. Other operations request a supported permission decision. Company permissions and execution boundaries still apply.
systemInstructions: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the system prompt at runtime.
codexInstructions: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the system prompt at runtime. Note: Codex may still auto-apply repo-scoped AGENTS.md files from the workspace.
cursorInstructions: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the prompt at runtime.
geminiInstructions: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Prepended to the Gemini prompt at runtime.
grokInstructions: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Paperclip stages it into the Grok workspace as Agents.md when possible.
kimiInstructions: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Prepended to the Kimi prompt at runtime.
theSelectedModeDoesNotWidenPaperclipSWor: The selected mode does not widen Paperclip's workspace, network, credential, or planning boundaries.
fastModeWillBePassedThroughForThisManual: Fast mode will be passed through for this manual model. If Codex rejects it, turn the toggle off.
fastModeConsumesCreditsTokensMuchFasterT: Fast mode consumes credits/tokens much faster than standard Codex runs.
unsupportedFastModeModels: Fast mode currently only works on {{models}} or manual model IDs. Paperclip will ignore this toggle until the model is switched.
